login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: One KayEdu account, every center you belong to.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: One account connects you to every center you work or study with.
register.confirmEmail: Check your inbox, confirm your email address, then sign in.

selectCenter.title: Choose a center
selectCenter.subtitle: You are connected to more than one center. Pick where you want to work.
selectCenter.emptySubtitle: Your account is not connected to a center yet.
selectCenter.emptyHelp: Ask a center owner or manager to invite you by email, or open the invitation link you were sent.

invite.title: Staff invitation
invite.subtitle: You have been invited to join {center} on KayEdu.
invite.signInToAccept: Sign in with the invited email address to accept.

errors.inviteExpired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.inviteEmailMismatch: This invitation was sent to a different email address.

Staff.title: Users & roles
Staff.subtitle: Invite staff and teachers to this center and manage who has access.
Staff.inviteSubtitle: The invitee accepts with the link below and gets a membership at this center.
Staff.membersSubtitle: Everyone connected to this center. Change a role or suspend access here.
Staff.pendingSubtitle: Invitations that have not been accepted yet.
Staff.inviteCreated: Invitation created. Share the link below with the invitee.
Staff.inviteLinkHint: Email delivery is not part of Phase 1, so send this link yourself. It expires in 7 days.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to invite people to this center.
errors.alreadyMember: That person already has this role at this center.
errors.ownerOnly: Only an owner can invite another owner.

match.title: This person already exists
match.description: They already have a KayEdu identity. Confirm to connect them to this center — a new record here, linked to the same person.

alreadyHere.student: They are already registered as a student at this center.
alreadyHere.teacher: They already teach at this center.
alreadyHere.staff: They are already a staff member at this center.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.notFound: That record no longer exists in this center.
errors.invalidPhone: Enter a valid Egyptian mobile number.
errors.contactRequired: Add a phone number or an email — a teacher needs one to be matched and to sign in later.
errors.invalidStudentCode: A student code may only contain letters, numbers and dashes.
errors.duplicateStudentCode: Another student at this center already has that code.
errors.samePromotionGrade: Choose a different grade to promote to.
errors.contactConflict: The email and the phone belong to two different people. Correct one of them, or ask a super admin to merge the identities.
errors.contactInUse: Those contact details already belong to someone else.
errors.matchGone: That person is no longer the match for these details. Check the form and try again.
errors.alreadyTeacher: They already teach at this center.
errors.alreadyStudent: They are already registered as a student at this center.
errors.alreadyBlocked: This student is already on that teacher's block-list.
errors.teacherInUse: This teacher still has classes or sessions here, so they cannot be deleted. Deactivate them instead.
errors.studentInUse: This student has attendance or payment history, so they cannot be deleted. Deactivate them instead.
errors.noStudentsToPromote: No active students are in that grade.
errors.photoType: Photos must be PNG, JPEG or WebP.
errors.photoTooLarge: That photo is larger than 5 MB.
errors.storage: File storage is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.

Teachers.title: Teachers
Teachers.subtitle: The teachers who work at this center, and who each of them will not take.
Teachers.addDescription: One person, one KayEdu identity. If they already teach elsewhere on KayEdu, you will be asked to link to them instead of creating a duplicate.
Teachers.listDescription: Deactivated teachers stay listed — hiding a former teacher is how a center loses track of its schedule.
Teachers.canSeeEarningsHint: What this center lets the teacher see financially in their own portal.
Teachers.linkAsTeacher: Link this person as a teacher
Teachers.detailSubtitle: Their record at this center, their classes and their block-list.
Teachers.profileDescription: Name and contact details belong to the person; financial visibility belongs to this center.
Teachers.profileLocked: This person has their own KayEdu account or works at another center too, so their name and contact details are theirs to change — not this center's. Everything below still is.
Teachers.identityDescription: How this person is connected across KayEdu.
Teachers.classesDescription: The classes this teacher carries at this center.
Teachers.classesEmpty: No classes yet — classes and schedules arrive with the next milestone.
Teachers.deleteConfirm: This removes them from this center. It cannot be undone.

blocks.title: Block-list
blocks.description: A student blocked here cannot be enrolled with, or added to a session of, this teacher.
blocks.empty: No students are blocked from this teacher.
blocks.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, code or phone

Students.title: Students
Students.subtitle: {count} registered at this center.
Students.addDescription: Register a student once and connect them to this center. A phone or email that already exists links to that person instead of creating a duplicate.
Students.centerSectionDescription: Grade, ID-card number and parent contacts belong to this center.
Students.linkAsStudent: Link this person as a student
Students.listDescription: Search by name, student code, or a student's or parent's phone.
Students.moreResults: Showing {shown} of {total}. Narrow the search to see the rest.
Students.detailSubtitle: Their record at this center, their enrolments and their ID card.
Students.profileDescription: The person's own details, then everything this center owns.
Students.profileLocked: This person has their own KayEdu account or is registered at another center too, so their name and contact details are theirs to change — not this center's. Everything below still is.
Students.deleteConfirm: This removes them from this center. It cannot be undone.

fields.studentCodeHint: The number on the ID card. Leave blank to assign the next one.

promote.title: Promote a grade
promote.description: At the end of a term, move every active student in one grade to the next.
promote.warning: This moves every active student in the chosen grade. The change is recorded in the audit log.
promote.needsGrades: Add at least two grades in settings before promoting.

photo.title: Photo
photo.description: Used on the ID card. Stored for this center only.
photo.label: Student photo
photo.hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB.

card.title: ID card
card.description: Laid out from this center's card customization, with a QR code the reception desk can scan.
card.notStored: No card has been generated for this student yet.
card.noStorage: File storage is not configured, so cards cannot be stored. Printing still works.

enrollments.title: Enrolments
enrollments.description: The classes this student is in at this center.
enrollments.empty: Not enrolled in any class yet — classes and enrolment arrive with the next milestone.
enrollments.emptyPrint: Not enrolled in any class yet.

blockedBy.title: Blocked by
blockedBy.description: Teachers who have blocked this student.
blockedBy.empty: No teacher has blocked this student.

print.hint: Only the sheet below is printed.

Settings.title: Center configuration
Settings.subtitle: Set up this center's academic and operational reference data. Everything here is per center — the next center needs no code changes.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to change this center's configuration.
errors.notFound: That record no longer exists in this center.
errors.inUse: Something still uses this record, so it cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
errors.duplicateName: That name is already used here.
errors.invalidAmount: Enter a valid amount in EGP.
errors.invalidPercent: Enter a whole percentage between 0 and 100.
errors.invalidShareType: Choose fixed EGP or a percentage.
errors.cardLayoutNotObject: The card layout must be a JSON object.
errors.ownerOnly: Only an owner can change another owner.
errors.lastOwner: This is the center's only owner. Add another owner first.
errors.selfEdit: You cannot change your own role or access.
errors.alreadyMember: That person already holds this role at this center.

general.title: General
general.description: The defaults a new class starts from, and how this center runs day to day.
general.cutDescription: The share this center takes from a session payment. Each class can override it; this is the starting point.
general.previewEmpty: Enter a value to see the split.
general.snapshotNote: Changing this never rewrites money already recorded — every payment keeps the split it was recorded with.
general.operationsDescription: Teacher inactivity, the default late threshold, and the clock this center runs on.
general.timeoutLabel: Mark a teacher inactive after a period with no sessions
general.timeoutDescription: Counted from their last completed session. Leave this off to never auto-deactivate a teacher.
general.lateThresholdHint: A class can set its own; this is what a new class starts with.

educationSystems.title: Education systems
educationSystems.description: The curricula this center teaches (National, Languages, IG…) and the price each one starts from.
educationSystems.addDescription: Grades and classes are organised under these.
educationSystems.listDescription: Deactivate one to keep it out of new classes without losing its history.
educationSystems.empty: No education systems yet. Add the first one above.

fields.name: Name
fields.basePriceHint: Per session, in EGP. A class can charge something different.

grades.title: Grades
grades.description: The year groups this center teaches, optionally tied to an education system.
grades.addDescription: Subjects, students and classes all hang off a grade.
grades.listDescription: Deactivate a grade to retire it without touching the students already in it.
grades.empty: No grades yet. Add the first one above.
grades.noSystemsHint: You have no education systems yet. Grades work without one, but adding systems first keeps the taxonomy tidy.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.description: What is taught, per grade. The same subject name can repeat across grades.
subjects.addDescription: A class is a teacher teaching one subject to one grade.
subjects.listDescription: Deactivate a subject to stop new classes using it.
subjects.empty: No subjects yet. Add the first one above.
subjects.noGradesHint: You have no grades yet. Add grades first so each subject can sit under one.

branches.title: Branches
branches.description: The physical locations this center runs. Rooms and sessions belong to a branch.
branches.addDescription: A single-location center needs just one.
branches.listDescription: Deactivate a branch that has closed; its history stays intact.
branches.empty: No branches yet. Add the first one above.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Where sessions physically happen. Capacity is used to warn about over-booking.
rooms.addDescription: Name it the way staff say it out loud — that is what they will pick from.
rooms.listDescription: Deactivate a room that is out of service.
rooms.empty: No rooms yet. Add the first one above.
rooms.noBranchesHint: You have no branches yet. Rooms work without one, but assigning a branch keeps multi-location scheduling straight.

fields.name: Name
fields.capacityHint: Seats. Use 0 if you do not want a limit.

card.title: ID card
card.description: Where the logo, photo, name, grade, student code and QR block sit on this center's printed student card.
card.rendererNote: The card itself is generated in a later milestone (M3). This screen stores the layout it will use.
card.editorDescription: A JSON object. Positions are percentages of the card face, so the same layout works on screen and at print size.
card.emptyHint: Leave this empty to use the built-in default card.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: The few role edges this center can widen. A grant can only add — it never takes away what a role already has.
permissions.receptionistDescription: Both are denied by default. Turn one on only if this center's front desk genuinely needs it.
permissions.viewProfitLabel: Can see center profit and settlement figures
permissions.viewProfitDescription: Off by default: the desk records money but does not see what the center keeps.
permissions.correctAttendanceDescription: Corrections are always written to the audit log, whoever makes them.
permissions.effectiveDescription: What a {role} at this center can do right now, resolved through the same check the server enforces.
permissions.widenOnlyNote: Owners and managers always have both; these toggles apply to receptionists only.

CenterDashboard.title: {center}
CenterDashboard.subtitle: Today at a glance.
CenterDashboard.milestoneNote: Milestone M1 is in place: identity, memberships, center selection and tenant-scoped access. The daily loop (reception, sessions, attendance, payments) arrives in M5.

TeacherDashboard.title: Teacher dashboard
TeacherDashboard.subtitle: Your work at {center}.
TeacherDashboard.milestoneNote: Your schedule, sessions, students and earnings land in M7.

StudentSchedule.title: My schedule
StudentSchedule.subtitle: Your classes at {center}.
StudentSchedule.milestoneNote: Your schedule and class discovery arrive in M8.

AdminCenters.title: Centers
AdminCenters.subtitle: Every tenant on the platform.
AdminCenters.empty: No centers yet. Run the seed script to create one.
AdminCenters.milestoneNote: Creating, activating and suspending tenants from here arrives in M9.
